name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Dong guan Yi Ren Mei Electric CO.,LTD(formerly named YIMEI) was established in 2001, located in 2nd Industrial Zone, Huan'gang Village, Houjie Town ,Dongguan City . We have a good reputation, devoting ourselves to producing and selling instruments for beauty care and health care. We focus on research, design, production and sales.



For years, under the management philosophy of orienting the market, we have successfully developed hundreds of types of beauty and health care instruments, especially the trademark of "Pully"and"Somon.R.N". Because of humanized management, we have been introduced a large number of expert technicians, management and marketing personnel.



Our products have gotten CE certificate. Also, our company has gotten ISO9001:2000 certificate. Through our continuous effort, in hope of achieving the leader position in beauty and health care instrument line, we assure we will offer our best service to create a bright future
